steps.name: increase_noise
steps.expr:
clip(
  clip(
    (
      clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
      * clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
      * clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
    )
    / (
      1
      - clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
      + 0.0001
    ),
    0, 1
  )
  + 0.0257*(
      clip(
        (
          clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
          * clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
          * clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
        )
        / (
          1
          - clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
          + 0.0001
        ),
        0, 1
      ) + 0.0001
    )
  + 0.004*(
      clip(
        (
          clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
          * clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
          * clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
        )
        / (
          1
          - clip((noise_increase - noise_decrease)/((noise_increase - noise_decrease) + 3000000), 0, 1)
          + 0.0001
        ),
        0, 1
      ) + 0.0001
    ) * (2*(rand_beta(2,2) - 0.5)),
  0, 1
)
